author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the State of Unreal, live from Unreal Fest Chicago! Tune in for news about Epic’s developer tools and services, highlights from across the community, and a look at what's ahead.

This year is about tools and workflows developers can actually use to build great games and experiences. Expect real conversations, not massive live tech demos.

The show begins at 7 AM PT | 9 AM CT | 10 AM ET | 3 PM BST on June 17.

description:

Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in The Guild: Europa 1410. The Guild: Europa 1410 will be available in Early Access on PC on July 16, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest.

In the demo, step into the bustling city of Kuttenberg and choose one of three professions: Smith, Innkeeper, or Alchemist. Across 17 turns, aspiring merchants, craftsmen, and entrepreneurs will get an early glimpse of the economic, social, and political systems that form the foundation of the full game.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust trailer as the second expansion DLC for society survival city-builder presents an all-new scenario, placing players in the centre of turmoil in New Edinburgh. As the First Citizen, you'll be subject to periodic Votes of Trust. But the toughest test arrives once Aurora - a nearby colony set on a frozen lake - proves to be the only possible safe haven for the city's people. Then comes the choice: trust or force. Unity or control. Breach of Trust features a new story exploring the fate of New Edingburgh, 5 unique communities and factions, lethal new environmental hazards, new narrative events, Independent Colony, 2 new scenario maps, 5 new buildings and hubs to reinforce your city's infrastructure, and new laws. 

The Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust expansion will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on June 23, 2026.
title: Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust - Official New Scenario Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the creepy trailer for Antichrist, an upcoming psychological horror game from developer Dead Witness. Antichrist will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. A demo is out now on Steam.

As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to a horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.
title: Antichrist - Official Demo Launch Trailer
